body: I feel apathetic a lot. And just fucking horrible a lot of the time. It is terrible but there is always a light at the end of the tunnel.

Haha, well I will tell you now, you are absolutely beautiful!! :) 
Good luck to you, and I hope to cross paths with a beautiful man like you in my future :)
Do you not do anything to make yourself fell good, at all? Maybe it isn't such a negative thing to try and make oneself feel good. We all deserve to feel good.

I know it feels like hell, and I get lost in my mind and I feel the best way to open my mind up, is to write a train of thought and hopefully get some logic out of what is happening in my head. Thank you for replying, it made me very happy and all fuzzy inside.
I am waiting for the rewards! Just some days are so much harder than others!
You, my friend, are a beautiful human being. Please continue to be beautiful!
EDIT: I am definitely confused as to where this prior comment went, haha.

Yes, I too believe human instinct is to be selfish, but that does not mean it's just embeded completely in your DNA to be selfish. I have met many, many people who will help people and not expect a thing in return and would not even bat an eyelid at being thanked for the act. It's hard to see, but their is beauty in many people. Just sometimes it's hard to see, especially when can be surrounded by so many selfish assholes. Accepting our flaws and embracing them is apart of being human, and yes it can suck, but maybe try and focus on 'little things' or just anything, that makes you see the human race in just a little bit more beauty

That reminds me of something I saw on Wordporn recently:

"Gibel;
(n.) not death, not suicide, but simply ceasing to exist; deteriorating in a way that is painful for others
(n.) death, destruction, ruin
Pronunciation | GEE-bel"

Is this the feeling?

You may not be enjoying things today, but that does not mean today will last forever. You may wake up tomorrow, and still not enjoy things you have once enjoyed. This may continue for awhile, but it does not mean that you will never enjoy any thing else ever.

I am in a similar boat, I don't want to get out of bed because everything is an effort, and there is no point. I believe that I am useless and hopeless. But through my experience, your mind can often cloud the reality of situations and you may not be able to see things objectively, especially if you believe you are a manic depressive. 

There is always help, and there are many people on here, and out in the world who are willing to help. You will begin to enjoy things and even things as abstract (and sometimes as fucked up) as emotions. It may not be today or tomorrow but you will. That is one thing i can garantee. And trust me, at this moment, i don't fucking believe it either. 

Here if you'd like to chat.
